name: how-it-works
description: Three-step process — numbered cards with title + description. Best for onboarding-style explainers ('Sign up → Connect → Deploy'). Composes Section + Container + Headline + Eyebrow + Card + Icon.

ai.whenToUse: Use to make a 3-step process feel inevitable. Best for products with non-obvious onboarding, agencies/services explaining engagement, or local businesses explaining 'how it works' to first-time customers.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use for processes with more than 4 steps (visual weight collapses). Don't use when the product is self-explanatory — adds friction without value.

headline.example: From git push to live URL in 12 seconds

subheadline.example: Three steps, no YAML — we figured that part out so you don't have to.

steps.description: Process steps. 3 is the sweet spot; 4 is the max. Each has a `title` and `description`; optional `icon` for visual interest.

example.description: GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket — pick one, OAuth in.
